lazy_chunks.options.title: LazyChunks
lazy_chunks.option.lazyChunkLoadingEnabl: Spread chunk-related packet processing across multiple frames.
Show LazyChunks metrics in the F3 debug overlay.
lazy_chunks.option.targetFps.tooltip: Baseline FPS used to calculate per-frame chunk processing budget.
lazy_chunks.option.fpsThreshold.tooltip: When 1% low FPS is above this value, LazyChunks stops throttling.
lazy_chunks.option.baseWeightPerFrame.to: Base chunk packet weight processed per frame at target FPS.
lazy_chunks.option.maxFrameTimePercent.t: Maximum percentage of target frame time spent processing chunk packets.
lazy_chunks.option.proactiveThrottling.t: Reduce chunk loading when frame times or queue growth become unstable.
lazy_chunks.option.teleportProtection.to: Use a more conservative budget briefly after teleporting or changing dimensions.
lazy_chunks.option.minimumBudget.tooltip: Minimum packet weight budget, kept high enough to process at least one heavy packet.
lazy_chunks.option.adaptiveBudgetBoostEn: Raise the chunk budget when low FPS persists but vanilla FPS has enough headroom.
lazy_chunks.option.adaptiveLowFpsThresho: 1% low FPS threshold used to start adaptive core boost timing.
lazy_chunks.option.adaptiveLowFpsDuratio: Seconds that 1% low FPS must remain low before adaptive core boost is allowed.
lazy_chunks.option.adaptiveAverageFpsThr: Vanilla FPS must be above this before adaptive core boost can activate.
lazy_chunks.option.adaptiveMaxBoostCores: Maximum adaptive cores that can be added to the budget.
lazy_chunks.option.adaptiveBoostWeightPe: Extra packet weight budget added by each adaptive core.
lazy_chunks.option.adaptiveFpsPerBoostCo: Additional vanilla FPS headroom required for each extra adaptive core.
